# Onboarding Research Note 3

Prior research on comparable products shows onboarding handling of progress interacts with guidance; teams noted that tutorial depends on walkthrough and completion, especially under real production load. Field notes from three pilot teams confirm onboarding handling of activation interacts with checklist; teams noted that stepper depends on invite and milestone, especially under real production load. Benchmarking across vendors surfaced evidence that onboarding handling of wizard interacts with empty state; teams noted that placeholder depends on trial and sample data, especially under real production load. A literature scan of similar systems found that onboarding handling of quickstart interacts with tooltip; teams noted that guided tour depends on skip button and welcome, especially under real production load.
